title: quercus toza var. aurea
intro: Quercus toza var. aurea, commonly known as the Golden Oak, is a variety of the Quercus toza tree, native to the Himalayan region. It is a deciduous tree known for its golden-hued leaves and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The health benefits of Quercus toza var. aurea include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood sugar levels. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
